profileroo.config.generic.comment.autoSw:
On joining a server or a world, switch to the profile
given by the rules on the "Servers" tab
profileroo.config.generic.comment.rememb:
Switching profiles by hand on a server without a rule
adds a rule "this server -> this profile".
Servers that already have a rule are left alone.
profileroo.config.generic.comment.messag: Where to say that joining switched the profile
Where to say that a hotkey switched the profile
profileroo.config.generic.comment.shared:
Options that are the same in every profile: switching never changes them.
A line is mod:Category.option, * and ? work:
  tweakeroo:Generic.* - the whole Generic tab of Tweakeroo
  *:TweakHotkeys - the same binds everywhere, only the toggles differ
  minihud - all of MiniHUD
A line starting with ! takes options out; the last matching line wins.
Categories are the top level keys in config/<mod>.json
profileroo.config.generic.comment.debugL: Log which config files were found for each mod
profileroo.config.hotkey.comment.nextPro: Switch to the next profile in the list
profileroo.config.hotkey.comment.previou: Switch to the previous profile in the list
profileroo.config.hotkey.comment.savePro:
Save the current settings into the active profile,
even if it is locked
profileroo.config.hotkey.comment.resetPr:
Throw away the changes made since the active profile
was last saved

profileroo.command.help:
#profile - profiles and what applies here
#profile <name> - switch to a profile
#profile next | prev - next / previous profile
#profile save [name] - save the current settings into a profile
#profile reset - throw away unsaved changes
#profile create <name> - new profile from the current settings
#profile copy <from> <to> | rename <old> <new> | delete <name>
#profile lock [name] | unlock [name]
#profile bind [name] - bind this server to a profile
#profile unbind - remove this server's rule
#profile gui - open the menu
profileroo.gui.message.confirm_delete: Profile %s will be deleted together with the rules that point to it. Its folder goes to config/profileroo/trash.
profileroo.gui.message.confirm_save: Profile %s gets the current settings of all mods, what it had is lost.
profileroo.gui.label.mods_help_1: MaLiLib mods with settings. "Switched" - profiles keep and change its config.
profileroo.gui.label.mods_help_2: Single options shared by all profiles are on the "Settings" tab (Shared options).
profileroo.gui.hover.new_profile_name: Name of the new profile: letters, digits, _ . + -
profileroo.gui.hover.create:
A new profile as a copy of the current settings of all mods.
The profile in use stays the same.
profileroo.gui.hover.use:
Switch to this profile: the current settings are saved
into the profile in use, the mods load this one
profileroo.gui.hover.lock:
A locked profile does not remember changes made in game:
every join brings the saved settings back.
Update it with "Save here".
profileroo.gui.hover.save_here: Save the current settings of the mods into this profile
profileroo.gui.hover.copy: Copy the profile under a new name
profileroo.gui.hover.delete: Delete the profile (its folder goes to config/profileroo/trash)
profileroo.gui.hover.delete_active: The profile in use cannot be deleted - switch first
profileroo.gui.hover.move: Profile order, for the next / previous hotkeys
profileroo.gui.hover.fallback_multiplaye: Used on servers without a rule
profileroo.gui.hover.fallback_singleplay: Used in singleplayer worlds without a rule
profileroo.gui.hover.locked: Locked: changes made in game are not saved
profileroo.gui.hover.pattern_help:
Rules are checked top to bottom, the first match wins.
play.example.com - this server, any port
play.example.com:25566 - server and port
*.example.com, 192.168.1.* - masks with * and ?
name:SMP* - by the name in the server list
sp - any singleplayer world, sp:Creative* - by world name
lan - LAN games, realms or realms:<name> - Realms
profileroo.gui.hover.cycle_profile: Left click - next profile, right click - previous
profileroo.gui.hover.fallback: When no rule matches. "Keep current" leaves the profile that is on.
profileroo.gui.hover.bind_current: Put a rule %s -> the profile in use at the top
profileroo.gui.hover.bind_current_offlin: Works when you are on a server or in a world
profileroo.gui.hover.mod_toggle: "Left alone" - profiles neither save nor change this mod's settings
profileroo.gui.hover.mod_in_active: The profile in use (%s) has this mod's settings
profileroo.gui.hover.mod_not_in_active: The profile in use (%s) has no settings of this mod yet - they come with the next save
